#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s, ss = "";
    int flag = 0, max_len = 0;

    // Read two lines, ignore first
    getline(cin, s);
    getline(cin, s);

    // Replace underscores with spaces and trim
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            s[i] = ' ';
        }
    }
    // Trim leading/trailing spaces
    size_t start = s.find_first_not_of(' ');
    size_t end = s.find_last_not_of(' ');
    if (start == string::npos) {
        s = "";
    } else {
        s = s.substr(start, end - start + 1);
    }

    // Extract characters inside parentheses into ss
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == '(') {
            flag = 1;
        } else if (s[i] == ')') {
            ss += ' ';
            flag = 0;
        } else if (flag == 1) {
            ss += s[i];
        }
    }

    // Remove parentheses and their contents from s
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == ')') {
            size_t openPos = s.find('(');
            if (openPos != string::npos) {
                s = s.substr(0, openPos) + " " + s.substr(i + 1);
                i = 0; // restart loop
            }
        } else if (s[i] == ')' && i == s.length() - 1) {
            size_t openPos = s.find('(');
            if (openPos != string::npos) {
                s = s.substr(0, openPos);
                i = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    // Replace multiple spaces with single space and trim
    string temp;
    bool space = false;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == ' ') {
            if (!space) {
                temp += ' ';
                space = true;
            }
        } else {
            temp += c;
            space = false;
        }
    }
    s = temp;
    // Trim leading/trailing spaces
    start = s.find_first_not_of(' ');
    end = s.find_last_not_of(' ');
    if (start == string::npos) {
        s = "";
    } else {
        s = s.substr(start, end - start + 1);
    }

    // Similarly for ss
    temp = "";
    space = false;
    for (char c : ss) {
        if (c == ' ') {
            if (!space) {
                temp += ' ';
                space = true;
            }
        } else {
            temp += c;
            space = false;
        }
    }
    ss = temp;
    start = ss.find_first_not_of(' ');
    end = ss.find_last_not_of(' ');
    if (start == string::npos) {
        ss = "";
    } else {
        ss = ss.substr(start, end - start + 1);
    }

    // Split s by spaces
    vector<string> out;
    stringstream ss_s(s);
    string word;
    while (ss_s >> word) {
        out.push_back(word);
    }

    // Split ss by spaces
    vector<string> in;
    stringstream ss_ss(ss);
    while (ss_ss >> word) {
        in.push_back(word);
    }

    // Find max length in out
    for (const string& w : out) {
        if (w.length() > max_len) {
            max_len = w.length();
        }
    }

    // Output
    if (!ss.empty() && ss != " ") {
        cout << max_len << " " << in.size() << endl;
    } else {
        cout << max_len << " " << "0" << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
